content_sections.heading: How to Obtain the Aadhaar Supervisor Certificate Before Applying
content_sections.text: Candidates who do not yet hold the mandatory Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate need to complete two steps before they are eligible to apply for CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra jobs. First, they must apply for and pass the Aadhaar Supervisor exam; second, they must complete the LMS certification. Both processes are managed through official UIDAI platforms. Visit the Aadhaar Supervisor exam portal at https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action and submit your exam application. An authorization request will be sent to the State Team. Once approved, you will be permitted to appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam. After your LMS ID and Password are created and approved, appear for the Aadhaar LMS Certification through the portal at https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in Once certified, proceed to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor district post on the CSC Job Portal.

content_sections.heading: Common Mistakes to Avoid in CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Many candidates make avoidable errors while applying for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Vacancy 2026 that can lead to rejection of their application. The points below are based on common patterns seen in similar contractual government recruitment drives and are not derived from the official notification. Applying without a valid UIDAI certificate: The Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate from a UIDAI-authorized agency is a mandatory requirement. Applying without it will result in disqualification. VLEs applying despite ineligibility: VLEs are explicitly barred from applying. Submitting an application as a VLE wastes your time and will be rejected at the verification stage. Applying for the wrong district: Each vacancy is district-specific. Ensure you apply for the correct district as per your location and preference. Incomplete LMS Certification: Candidates sometimes have the Supervisor exam cleared but not the LMS Certification. Both are required before applying. Submitting incorrect documents: Upload clear, legible scans of your educational certificates and Aadhaar Operator certificate. Blurry or mismatched documents can cause rejection. Missing the last date: The portal closes applications on 31 August 2026. Do not wait until the last day — technical issues near the deadline are common. Confusing CSC e-Governance with state government jobs: This is a contractual, not permanent government post. Ensure you understand the terms of engagement before applying.

faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026 is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th, or Matriculation with 2 years ITI, or Matriculation with a 3-year Polytechnic Diploma.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 18 years old. No maximum age limit or age relaxation details have been specified in the recruitment information.

faq.question: Q5. Is an Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate mandatory for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must possess a valid Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor Certificate issued by a Testing & Certifying Agency authorized by UIDAI. Basic computer skills are also required.

faq.question: Q6. Can VLEs apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. Village Level Entrepreneurs (VLEs) are not eligible to apply for the Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator - District post under this recruitment.
